companies.title: Companies
companies.subtitle: Publishers and developers – the same for everyone, like the whole catalog.
companies.uses: {n} game developed or release published | {n} games developed or releases published

genres.title: Genres
genres.subtitle: Genres of the games – the same for everyone, like the whole catalog.

series.title: Series
series.subtitle: Game series – a game can belong to several.

terms.unused: Not used by any game yet.
terms.catalogHint: Applies to the whole catalog, for every library.
terms.name: Name
terms.nameHint: If the name exists already, merge the two instead.
terms.deleteText: The games stay, only this entry goes. | The game stays, it only loses this entry. | The {n} games stay, they only lose this entry.
terms.mergeHint: For duplicates and typos: every game of this entry gets the picked one, then this one is deleted.
terms.pickTarget: Pick the entry that should stay.
terms.moves: No game changes | {n} game changes | {n} games change
terms.movesHint: These games get the picked entry.
terms.noneOwned: None of these games is in your library.
terms.imageHint: A logo or picture for the page – SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Saved right away.

describe.title: Description from {source}
describe.hint: Which entry at {source} is it? Its text becomes the description – in every language there is, with the source credited.
describe.logoHint: The entry's logo becomes the page's picture.
describe.logoReplaces: Replaces the current picture with the entry's logo.
describe.factsOnly: No text – only details such as founding, country and website.

details.title: Company
details.hint: What is known about the company – also filled from Wikipedia when you take a description from there.

images.title: Choose picture
images.hint: Every picture of the linked entries, older logos too. One click makes it the page's picture.
images.none: No pictures yet – take a description from a source first, then its logos show up here.
images.platformHint: Every picture of the linked entries: logos, small logos and photos. Each can become the page's logo, its photo or the badge's icon.
images.commonsHint: For photos or a missing icon: e.g. “Nintendo DS icon” or “Nintendo DS Lite console”.

franchises.title: Franchises
franchises.subtitle: Brands above the series (“Mario” above “Super Mario” and “Mario Kart”) – a game can belong to several.

terms.franchiseOfHint: The brand the series belongs to (“Mario Kart” → “Mario”). Taken from Wikidata when the franchise is in the catalog.
